text: My Apple ID was locked for security reasons and I lost my trusted phone number!
We take security seriously! You can safely unlock and reset your Apple ID password at iforgot.apple.com. Identity verification may be required.
Someone stole my iPhone at a concert last night! How do I lock it?
Act immediately! Go to iCloud.com/find from any browser to mark your iPhone as Lost, lock it, and suspend Apple Pay right away.
I got an email saying someone signed into my Apple ID from another country!
Your account safety is critical. Change your Apple ID password immediately at appleid.apple.com and review trusted devices under 2FA settings.
The battery on my iPhone has swollen up and is pushing the screen outward!
SAFETY WARNING: Please stop charging and using your iPhone immediately. Keep it away from heat and visit support.apple.com/repair for professional service inspection.
I dropped my iPhone 15 Pro Max and the back glass shattered into pieces.
Oh no! We recommend having a certified technician inspect the shattered glass safely. Visit support.apple.com/repair to check AppleCare+ pricing and schedule an appointment.
My iPad charger port has a broken pin stuck inside it.
Do not attempt to insert metal tools into the charger port. Please book a service appointment at support.apple.com/repair so a Genius Bar technician can clean it safely.
My card was charged three times for the same Apple Music subscription this month!
Duplicate charges definitely need to be corrected. Please check reportproblem.apple.com to verify purchase history, or DM us your details so billing support can inspect it.
I was charged $49.99 for an app subscription I canceled last week!
We can help you request a refund! Visit reportproblem.apple.com, log in with your Apple ID, find the charge, and click 'Request a refund'.
How do I upgrade from 50GB iCloud storage to 200GB family sharing plan?
Upgrading is easy! Go to Settings > [Your Name] > iCloud > Manage Account Storage > Change Storage Plan, then select 200GB and tap Subscribe to iCloud+.
My iPhone battery drops from 80% to 10% in less than an hour after updating.
Rapid battery drain right after an update can happen while system indexing completes. Check Settings > Battery to find high usage apps and try a force restart.
My Wi-Fi keeps disconnecting every 5 minutes on my iPad Pro.
Let's fix that connection! Go to Settings > Wi-Fi > Forget This Network, then reconnect. You can also try Reset Network Settings.
My iPhone screen is completely frozen and unresponsive to touch.
To force restart a modern iPhone: press and quickly release Volume Up, then Volume Down, then hold the Side button until the Apple logo appears.
iOS 17 update download is stuck on Estimating Time Remaining for an hour.
Try deleting the downloaded installer! Go to Settings > General > iPhone Storage, find the iOS update, tap Delete Update, then go back to Software Update to redownload.
After updating to macOS Sonoma my MacBook screen shows a flashing question mark folder!
A flashing question mark means your Mac can't find its startup disk. Turn off your Mac, then hold Command + R while booting to enter macOS Recovery and run Disk Utility First Aid.
FedEx says my order was delivered today but there is no package! My $1500 laptop was stolen!
We take missing shipments very seriously. Please DM us your order number and full shipping name so our logistics team can open an immediate carrier investigation.
My trade-in kit for my old iPhone hasn't arrived in the mail yet.
Trade-in kits typically arrive within 3-5 business days after your new device ships. You can track trade-in kit delivery at apple.com/orderstatus.
Are Apple Stores open on Thanksgiving day in California?
Apple Store hours vary by retail location on holidays. You can check specific store holiday hours at apple.com/retail.
Please bring back the battery percentage icon inside the battery bar!
Thanks for sharing your feedback! We love hearing feature suggestions from our customers. You can submit product feedback directly to our design team at apple.com/feedback.
